HPCL-MS-0001.description: Motor Spirit (also known as Motor Gasoline) is a distillate fraction, normally boiling within the range 30°C to 210°C. It is a complex mixture composed of relatively volatile hydrocarbons (alkanes, alkenes and aromatics with typical carbon chain length of C5 to C10) that vary widely in their physical and chemical properties.

As on date regular MS is substituted by E20 MS. It is observed that E20 fuel is being used in existing spark-ignition engine. E20 fuel has several advantages over conventional MS, such as it reduces vehicular tailpipe emissions by lowering the carbon monoxide, hydrocarbons and nitrogen oxides levels.

HPCL-MS-0002.title: HSD (High Speed Diesel)
HPCL-MS-0002.subTitle: MOTOR FUEL
HPCL-MS-0002.description: High-Speed Diesel (HSD), also known as Automotive Diesel Fuel, is produced from the fractional distillation of crude oil between 200°C and 400°C resulting in a mixture of carbon chains and is composed of saturated hydrocarbons and aromatic hydrocarbons.

HPCL-MS-0002.appData: HSD is commonly used as a fuel in medium and high-speed compression ignition engine in commercial vehicle, stationery diesel engines, locomotive and pumps etc. It is also used as fuel in power generation (DG sets), agriculture and construction machinery.

HPCL-MS-0003.title: Ethanol
HPCL-MS-0003.subTitle: FUEL ADDITIVE FOR MS
HPCL-MS-0003.description:
Ethanol meant for E20 blending having purity of min. 99.5% and other components including water max. 0.5%. Anhydrous Ethanol is known as Ethyl Alcohol, is a clear, colourless and homogenous liquid with high purity, also known as Absolute Alcohol. 
Anhydrous Ethanol is categorized into 1G and 2G, based on its source of raw material used. 1G Ethanol produced from raw materials viz. sugarcane juice, molasses, damaged food grains. 2G Ethanol are generally made from biomass. 1G Ethanol is produced by subsidiary unit HPCL-MS--Biofuel Ltd.
HPCL-MS-0003.appData: Ethanol is an environment friendly fuel used for blending with Motor Spirit (MS).

HPCL-MS-0004.title: Kerosene
HPCL-MS-0004.subTitle: FUEL
HPCL-MS-0004.description: Kerosene is distillate fractions of crude oil in the boiling range of 150-250°C. It is a complex mixture of hydrocarbons from crude oil distillation, primarily containing alkanes (paraffins), cycloalkanes (naphthenes) and some aromatics like alkylbenzenes.

specifications.property: Colour Saybolt (in case of undyed Kerosene)
Colour Visual (in case of dyed Kerosene)

specifications.value: Not limited, but to be reported

HPCL-MS-0004.appData:
Kerosene is one of the most versatile hydrocarbon fuels in the industry. Kerosene is used in many industrial applications like heating, cleaning and as thinner. It is also used for lighting lamps in areas where electricity is not available. Use of Public Distribution System (PDS) Kerosene (Blue Dyed) has reduced drastically. 
Kerosene with ultra-low sulfur content upto 10 mg/kg is used as pipeline compatible plug material (PCK) in multi-product pipeline operations in Petroleum Industry. Chemical industry uses kerosene as a petroleum solvent and in pesticide industry.
HPCL-MS-0004.industrial: Domestic Use, Petroleum Industry. Chemical Industry & Pesticide industry

HPCL-MS-0006.title: HP Turbojet
HPCL-MS-0006.subTitle: MOTOR FUEL
HPCL-MS-0006.description: HP Turbojet is premium branded fuel produced by addition of special high quality additives which enhances overall performance of High Speed Diesel.
HPCL-MS-0006.appData: Used as a fuel in medium and high-speed compression ignition engines in high-end vehicles.

HPCL-MS-0009.title: POWER100
HPCL-MS-0009.subTitle: SPECIAL MOTOR FUEL
HPCL-MS-0009.description: Power100 is premium branded Motor Spirit with Research Octane Number (RON) 100 and no Ethanol. It is produced by addition of special high quality additives which enhance the overall performance of Motor Spirit and deliver superior engine efficiency and responsiveness.
HPCL-MS-0009.appData: Recommended for luxury and high-end cars requiring very high octane fuel for improved engine performance, acceleration and combustion efficiency.

HPCL-IF-0001.title: LAN (Low Aromatic Naphtha)
HPCL-IF-0001.subTitle: INDUSTRIAL FEEDSTOCK/FUEL
HPCL-IF-0001.description: Petroleum naphtha is a complex mixture of hydrocarbons, primarily C5–C8 alkanes (paraffins), cycloparaffins, and aromatics, with specific compositions varying significantly based on the crude oil source and refining process. It contains higher percentage of paraffins and low percentage of aromatic hydrocarbons (such as benzene, toluene, and xylene). It also contains sulfur compounds.
HPCL-IF-0001.appData: Naphtha is used by refineries in blending of petroleum products, isomerization, reforming, and in the production of value-added products. Naphtha serves as a primary feedstock for the production of gasoline. It is also a crucial component in the manufacturing of various petrochemical products, including plastics, fertilizers, and synthetic fibres. Naphtha is a key raw material for the production of various plastics, including polyethylene (PE), polypropylene (PP), and polystyrene (PS).

HPCL-IF-0002.title: FOOD GRADE HEXANE
HPCL-IF-0002.subTitle: PROCESS SOLVENT
HPCL-IF-0002.description: Food Grade Hexane is a highly purified petroleum distillate fraction that contains a high proportion of n-hexane with boiling range of 63 to 70°C. It is a clear colourless liquid with distinct odour, free from sediment, suspended matter and moisture.
HPCL-IF-0002.appData: Food Grade Hexane is used in Food processing industry as a solvent to extract edible oils with minimum harmful residue to meet strict purity standards set by statutory bodies such as FSSAI. It is also used in Drug and Pharmaceuticals industry for drug extraction and as a cleaning agent.

HPCL-IF-0003.title: Solvent 1425
HPCL-IF-0003.subTitle: PROCESS SOLVENT
HPCL-IF-0003.description: Solvent 1425 is a petroleum-derived industrial solvent having a complex mixture of petroleum hydrocarbons that vary widely in their physical and chemical properties with boiling range between 50 - 120°C. Solvent 1425 is having strong solvency power due to its wide chemical composition. Solvent 1425 is having higher evaporation rate that improves efficiency of the solvent.

specifications.property: Distillation 50 % by volume recovered at, in °C
Distillation 95 % by volume recovered at, in °C

HPCL-IF-0003.appData: Solvent 1425 is a highly versatile hydrocarbon solvent with a wide range of industrial and commercial applications. Solvent 1425 is a potent degreaser, effectively removing oil, grease, wax, and tar from various surfaces. It is commonly used in cleaning engines, parts and tools. Solvent 1425 finds application in the paint and coatings industry. It is used for diluting paints, varnishes, and lacquers to adjust viscosity and improve application. Solvent 1425 as a cleaning and degreasing agent in leather and rubber industry.

HPCL-IF-0004.title: MTO (Mineral Turpentine Oil) / Solvent 2445
HPCL-IF-0004.subTitle: PROCESS SOLVENT
HPCL-IF-0004.description: Solvent 2445, commonly referred to as MTO, is a petroleum-derived aliphatic hydrocarbon solvent obtained from the middle distillate/naphtha range. It is a water-white, highly volatile, low-viscosity solvent used extensively in paints, adhesives, and chemical industries. It has boiling range between 125 - 240°C.

specifications.property: Distillation 50 % by volume recovered at, in °C
Distillation 95 % by volume recovered at, in °C

HPCL-IF-0004.appData: Solvent 2445 is a versatile and widely used solvent with significant applications across industries. Solvent 2445's high solvency power, low toxicity, moderate evaporation rate, and inertness make it a valuable substance in various cleaning, degreasing, and dissolving processes. Its unique properties make it an essential component in the formulation of paints, adhesives, inks, and numerous other products.

HPCL-IF-0005.title: FO (MV2 Grade)
HPCL-IF-0005.subTitle: INDUSTRIAL FUEL
HPCL-IF-0005.description: Fuel oil is a dark viscous residual fuels obtained by blending mainly heavier components from crude distillation unit. It is generally consisted of heavy petroleum product. Efficiency and type of fuel oil widely varies depending on kinematic viscosity and sulphur content.

specifications.value: Not limited, but to be reported

specifications.property: Density at 15°C kg/m3 or Relative density at 15.6/15.6°C
specifications.value: Not limited, but to be reported

HPCL-IF-0005.appData: Fuel oil is used as a backup fuel for power generation in facilities where a reliable power supply is crucial. It is used in thermal power plants for boiler start up. It serves as a contingency option during periods of fuel shortages or interruptions in primary fuel sources. Fuel oil is used in various industrial applications for heating purposes. Cement and Steel plants use fuel oil as a source of energy in furnaces for high heat processes.
HPCL-IF-0005.industrial: Power, Marine, Manufacturing (Steel, Cement, Glass, Ceramic Industries)

HPCL-IF-0006.title: Heating Oil (LDO)
HPCL-IF-0006.subTitle: INDUSTRIAL FUEL
HPCL-IF-0006.description: Heating Oil also known as Light Diesel Oil (LDO) consists of medium length chains of hydrogen and carbon mainly alkanes, cycloalkanes, aromatics and oils. Basically, Heating oil is termed for medium commercial extracts from crude oil. It is either distilled or residual fraction of various oils that is extracted while distillation. It has a lower flash point compared to heavier Fuel Oil (FO), for easier ignition.

specifications.value: on whole samples, percent by mass, Max 1.5

HPCL-IF-0006.appData: LDO is known for its efficient combustion properties. This fuel is free flowing in nature. It finds extensive use in industries such as manufacturing, power generation, and heating systems. It is commonly used in boilers, furnaces, and other equipment that require a steady and controlled source of heat.

HPCL-IF-0007.title: HFHSD (High Flash High Speed Diesel - Distillate Marine Fuel )
HPCL-IF-0007.subTitle: MARINE FUEL
HPCL-IF-0007.description: High Flash High Speed Diesel (HFHSD) is a special grade of diesel fuel with flash point (Min. 66°C) significantly higher than that of HSD (Min. 35°C). It consists of hydrocarbons with carbon numbers predominantly in the range of C9 to C28, with a boiling range of approximately 150°C to 400°C. It is produced by refining middle-distillate fractions to meet stringent safety and performance specifications IS 16731(ISO 8217).

specifications.property: Carbon residue – Micro method on the 10 % volume distillation residue

specifications.value: corrected wear scar diameter (WSD) at 60 °C, μm, Max 520

HPCL-IF-0007.appData: HFHSD is mainly manufactured for non-automotive applications. It is mainly applicable for marine use by Indian Navy, Merchant Ships, fishing vessels etc. where a high flash point diesel is required.

HPCL-IF-0008.title: VLSFO (Very Low Sulfur Fuel Oil) RMG380
HPCL-IF-0008.subTitle: MARINE FUEL
HPCL-IF-0008.description: VLSFO is a type of marine fuel that complies with the International Maritime Organization (IMO) – Marine Oil Pollution Control (MARPOL) regulations to reduce sulphur emissions from ships. It is generally blended from different refinery streams to achieve low sulfur levels while maintaining suitable viscosity and energy content for ship engines. VLSFO is a cleaner marine fuel with very low sulfur content (0.5% by wt. max./as per statutory norms) and prescribed limit of element content in fuel (Na, V, Al, Si, Ca, Zn, P).
HPCL-IF-0008.appData: VLSFO is primarily used as a marine fuel in ships to comply with IMO regulations. VLSFO is used in various types of vessels, including container ships, bulk carriers, etc.

HPCL-IF-0009.title: LSHS (Low Sulphur Heavy Stock)
HPCL-IF-0009.subTitle: INDUSTRIAL FUEL
HPCL-IF-0009.description: Low Sulphur Heavy Stock (LSHS) is a dense, viscous residual product from crude oil distillation, featuring a black, thick liquid form with Low Sulfur (Max. 1.8%) content as per customer requirement.
HPCL-IF-0009.appData: LSHS is used mainly in heavy industry, steel plants, and power plants as fuel. LSHS is mainly used in steel production and where the finished product to be heated are likely to get contaminated with sulfur.

HPCL-IF-0010.title: Paving Bitumen (VG10)
HPCL-IF-0010.subTitle: ROAD CONSTRUCTION MATERIAL
HPCL-IF-0010.description: Bitumen is obtained as the last residue in fractional distillation of crude petroleum. It is defined as a viscous liquid, or a solid, consisting essentially of complex mixture of hydrocarbons including high-molecular-weight compounds, such as asphaltenes, and lighter fractions, such as aromatics and saturates. It is substantially non-volatile and softens gradually when heated. It is black or brown in colour & possesses waterproofing and adhesive properties.
HPCL-IF-0010.appData: Paving bitumen is extensively used in the construction of roads, highways and airport tarmac.

HPCL-IF-0013.title: Jute Batching Oil
HPCL-IF-0013.subTitle: Wash Oil
HPCL-IF-0013.description: JBO is a mineral oil fraction, generally mixed with water and emulsifiers. This is traditionally mineral based modern ecofriendly versions.  JBs applied to raw jute fibers to soften them and give cohesion during processing.
HPCL-IF-0013.appData: JBO softens raw jute fibers for easier processing by adding flexibility and cohesion reducig breakage. It also used in steel plant to recover aromatics from oven gas.

HPCL-IF-0014.title: HM120A-MS
HPCL-IF-0014.subTitle: PP Homopolymer
HPCL-IF-0014.description: Polypropylene grade for manufacturing of raffia woven sack fabric and bag manufacturing.

HPCL-IF-0016.subTitle: PE Grade

HPCL-IF-0016.appData: Used for FMCG packaging, general packaging films and multilayer film applications.

HPCL-IF-0017.title: F02020-MS
HPCL-IF-0017.subTitle: PE Grade
HPCL-IF-0017.description: LLDPE grade for manufacturing of liners and agricultural films.
HPCL-IF-0017.appData: Used for FMCG packaging, industrial liners and agricultural film applications.

HPCL-IF-0018.title: FO 380
HPCL-IF-0018.subTitle: Marine Fuel
HPCL-IF-0018.description: FO 380 is a high-viscosity residual marine fuel primarily used in large ocean-going vessels equipped with slow-speed and medium-speed diesel engines. Traditionally supplied as High Sulfur Fuel Oil (HSFO) (up to 3.5% sulfur), its usage today is largely restricted to vessels fitted with exhaust gas cleaning systems (scrubbers) in order to comply with IMO 2020 sulfur regulations.
HPCL-IF-0018.appData: Fuel used in ocean-going vessels fitted with exhaust gas cleaning systems (scrubbers) to comply with IMO 2020 sulfur regulations.

HPCL-IF-0019.title: LSHS Premium
HPCL-IF-0019.subTitle: Bulk Fuels
HPCL-IF-0019.description: LSHS Premium (Low Sulphur Heavy Stock) is a dark viscous residual fuel obtained by blending mainly heavier components from crude distillation units. It consists primarily of heavy petroleum fractions and is widely used as an industrial fuel. Its performance varies depending on kinematic viscosity and sulphur content, with sulphur maintained below 1% to meet stricter environmental norms.

Not limited, but to be reported

HPCL-IF-0019.appData: Used as a replacement for FO 180 in regions with stricter NGT norms where sulphur content must be below 1%.

HPCL-IF-0020.title: Paving Bitumen (VG 40 Super)
HPCL-IF-0020.subTitle: Industrial Construction
HPCL-IF-0020.description: Bitumen is obtained as the last residue in fractional distillation of crude petroleum. It is substantially non-volatile and softens gradually when heated. It is black or brown in colour and possesses waterproofing and adhesive properties.
HPCL-IF-0020.appData: Paving bitumen is extensively used in the construction of roads, highways and airport tarmac.

HPCL-IF-0021.title: Crumb Rubber Modified Bitumen (CRMB55)
HPCL-IF-0021.subTitle: Industrial Construction
HPCL-IF-0021.description: Crumb Rubber Modified Bitumen (CRMB) is a high-performance asphalt binder produced by blending bitumen with crumb rubber derived from recycled tyres along with performance additives. It enhances road durability by improving flexibility, reducing cracking and resisting deformation under heavy traffic loads and extreme temperature conditions.

HPCL-IF-0023.title: BULK SULPHUR
HPCL-IF-0023.subTitle: Manufacturing
HPCL-IF-0023.description: Sulphur is a non-metallic, bright yellow brittle solid at room temperature. Known since antiquity as brimstone, it is primarily used in industrial production of sulfuric acid, fertilizers, and rubber vulcanization. Sulphur is produced as a by-product of removing sulphur-containing contaminants from petroleum refining processes.
HPCL-IF-0023.appData: Sulphur is widely used in industrial processes including production of sulfuric acid, fertilizers and chemicals, rubber vulcanization, paper production, sugar refining and manufacturing of explosives such as gunpowder.

HPCL-IF-0024.title: Propylene
HPCL-IF-0024.subTitle: Feedstock
HPCL-IF-0024.description: Propylene is a light, colorless hydrocarbon and an unsaturated alkene. It is produced during crude oil refining and steam cracking of hydrocarbons.
HPCL-IF-0024.appData: Propylene is widely used as a chemical feedstock for the production of polypropylene (PP) plastics, oxo alcohols used in plasticizers and solvents, acrylonitrile, propylene oxide and other petrochemical derivatives. It is also used as an octane enhancing component in gasoline blending.

HPCL-IF-0025.title: MS
HPCL-IF-0025.subTitle: Automotive fuel
HPCL-IF-0025.description: Motor Spirit (MS) is a light petroleum distillate used in spark-ignition internal combustion engines. It is produced through atmospheric distillation, catalytic reforming, isomerization and blending of various refinery streams. In India, Motor Spirit conforms to Bharat Stage VI (BS-VI) emission norms.
HPCL-IF-0025.appData: Primarily used as an automotive fuel for passenger vehicles including cars, motorcycles and scooters. It is also used in small generators, agricultural light machinery and recreational vehicles.

HPCL-IF-0026.title: HSD
HPCL-IF-0026.subTitle: Automotive fuel
HPCL-IF-0026.description: High Speed Diesel (HSD) is a middle distillate petroleum fuel used in compression ignition (CI) engines. It is the largest consumed petroleum product in India. HSD is refined from crude oil through atmospheric distillation followed by hydrotreating for sulfur removal and blending for performance compliance. In India, HSD conforms to Bharat Stage VI (BS-VI) emission norms.
HPCL-IF-0026.appData: Primarily used as an automotive fuel for passenger vehicles, heavy commercial vehicles such as trucks and buses, and rail locomotives. It is also widely used in construction and mining equipment, agricultural tractors, diesel generators and marine engines.

HPCL-IF-0027.title: ISKO
HPCL-IF-0027.subTitle: Heating & cleaning
HPCL-IF-0027.description: Superior Kerosene Oil (SKO) is a middle distillate petroleum fraction heavier than gasoline but lighter than diesel. It is produced during atmospheric distillation of crude oil. Historically used as a domestic fuel, its usage has declined with the introduction of cleaner fuel alternatives.
HPCL-IF-0027.appData: Traditionally used for domestic lighting in kerosene lamps and cooking in kerosene stoves, though usage has declined. It is also used in industrial burners, solvent applications, and as fuel for small boat engines.

HPCL-IF-0028.title: CBFS
HPCL-IF-0028.subTitle: Feedstock
HPCL-IF-0028.description: Carbon Black Feedstock (CBFS) is a heavy aromatic hydrocarbon oil used as the primary raw material for manufacturing carbon black. It is rich in aromatic hydrocarbons, which are essential for efficient carbon black formation in furnace-type reactors.
HPCL-IF-0028.appData: CBFS is used as a process feedstock for producing tyre-grade carbon black, rubber-grade carbon black, pigment-grade carbon black and specialty carbon black used in inks, coatings and plastics.

HPCL-IF-0029.title: Crumb Rubber Modified Bitumen (CRMB60)
HPCL-IF-0029.subTitle: Bitumen
HPCL-IF-0029.description: Crumb Rubber Modified Bitumen (CRMB) is a high-performance asphalt binder created by blending bitumen with crumb rubber derived from recycled tires along with special additives. It enhances road durability by improving flexibility, reducing cracking and resisting deformation under heavy traffic and extreme temperatures.

HPCL-IF-0029.appData: CRMB is extensively used in the construction of roads, highways and airport tarmac where improved durability, resistance to rutting and enhanced flexibility are required.

HPCL-LPG-0001.title: BUTANE
HPCL-LPG-0001.subTitle: LPG – Commercial / Industrial Fuel
HPCL-LPG-0001.description: Butane (C₄H₁₀) is a clean-burning, liquefiable hydrocarbon gas primarily used as a fuel and blending component in LPG. It is colourless and odourless in its natural form; an odorant such as Ethyl Mercaptan is added for leak detection and safety. Butane has a lower vapour pressure compared to Propane and delivers a high calorific value, making it suitable for commercial and industrial applications under moderate ambient conditions.
HPCL-LPG-0001.appData: Aerosol propellants, portable fuel cartridges for camping stoves and laboratory burners, specialty commercial kitchens operating at controlled indoor temperatures, laboratory and R&D applications, lighter fuel and specialty fuel cylinders.
HPCL-LPG-0001.industrial: Manufacturing & Processing Industries; Aerosol & Chemical Industries; Refrigerant and Specialty Gas Applications

HPCL-LPG-0002.title: PROPANE
HPCL-LPG-0002.subTitle: LPG – Commercial / Industrial Fuel
HPCL-LPG-0002.description: Propane (C₃H₈) is a highly volatile, clean-burning liquefied petroleum hydrocarbon gas used as an industrial and commercial fuel. It is colourless, odourless, and non-toxic in its natural state; an odorant such as Ethyl Mercaptan is added to facilitate leak detection and enhance operational safety. Propane has high vapour pressure and a low boiling point, ensuring reliable vaporisation even at low ambient temperatures, making it suitable for high-demand and cold-weather operations.
HPCL-LPG-0002.appData: Industrial heating & furnaces, LPG-based gensets, metal cutting/brazing/welding, vaporizers & process heating, cold-climate fuel applications.

HPCL-LPG-0003.title: HP GAS
HPCL-LPG-0003.subTitle: Domestic / Commercial / Industrial Fuel/Free trade LPG
HPCL-LPG-0003.description: HP GAS (LPG) is a clean, efficient, and high-calorific gaseous fuel comprising mainly of mixture of  Propane (C₃H₈) and Butane (C₄H₁₀) . It is colourless, odourless in natural form (odorized with Ethyl Mercaptan for safety), non-toxic. HP GAS is produced during petroleum refining and gas processing

They are also fortified with mild extreme pressure and rust preventive properties.It is a combined hydraulic and machine toolway lubricant possessing adequate lubricity to eliminate stickslip and chatter under moderate load condition and at the same time serves as hydraulic media in noncritical systems.
HPCL-LBS-0044.appData: WAYLUBE 68, 220 are recommended for slideway lubrication of planers, grinders, horizontal boring machines, shapers, jig borers etc, involving high precision work and are also recommended for lubrication of gears by oil can. WAYLUBE 68 is recommended for machine tools combined hydraulic and way lubrication systems. They meet CINCINNATI MILACRON thermal stability test P 47.

HPCL-LBS-0045.title: HYTAK
HPCL-LBS-0045.subTitle: OPEN GEAR LUBRICANTS
HPCL-LBS-0045.description: HYTAK series of lubricants are heavy, viscous, black petroleum products for the lubrication of open gears, chains and wire ropes. They all have a pronounced stringiness and excellent film strength to withstand high pressures encountered at the meshing tooth surfaces of heavily loaded open gears. They also possess good rust preventive properties and have ability to stay in place and provide long-lasting protection to wire ropes and open gears.
HPCL-LBS-0045.appData: HYTAK grades are recommended for the lubrication of conventional open gears, cables and wire-ropes. The heavier grades require heating before application and in liquid state they can be applied with swab, brush, paddle or spray. The extra tackiness of these grades helps them to stay in place and provide unusually longlasting protection to gear and wire-rope surfaces. As a result, the interval between applications of lubricant can be increased when HYTAK grades are employed. HYTAK F 4 and F 5 contain a non-flammable solvent for easy application without heating. After the application, the solvent evaporates leaving behind a tacky film that will neither be squeezed aside by the meshing action of teeth nor thrown off by centrifugal force. Additionally, extreme and tackiness additives are incorporated in these products to impart extreme-pressure lubricating properties and improve their rust-preventing characteristics.

HPCL-LBS-0046.title: HYTAK 500 NB
HPCL-LBS-0046.subTitle: OPEN GEAR LUBRICANTS
HPCL-LBS-0046.description: HYTAK 500 NB is semi-synthetic type viscous oil. The very high kinematic viscosity results in formation of thicker Elasto Hydrodynamic Lubrication (EHL) Film. The advanced extreme pressure additives package, results in reduction of temperature; thereby improving system efficiency. HYTAK 500 NB product is clear, and free from solids, heavy metals, diluents like chlorinated solvents or any toxic compound. The product is free from harmful Polycyclic Aromatic Compounds (DMSO Extractables < 3% wt). HYTAK 500 NB is recommended for open gear drives of ball mills, rotary kilns, rotary barrel mixers and dryers.

HPCL-LBS-0047.title: HYTAK 500 NB-1000
HPCL-LBS-0047.subTitle: OPEN GEAR LUBRICANTS
HPCL-LBS-0047.description: HYTAK 500 NB product is clear, and free from solids, heavy metals, diluents like chlorinated solvents or any toxic compound. It eliminates the black oils with asphaltene and carcinogenic effects and the black greases in the sugar industry. The product is free from harmful Polycyclic Aromatic Compounds (DMSO Extractables < 3% wt). The black oils and black greases used in most mills typically have high content of PCA which is harmful. Compared to the lubrication with Lithium-graphite/Lithium Complex MoS2-Graphite/ Aluminum Soap Graphite greases, it increases the lubrication reliability because it avoids the blockages in the tubing that usually happens by the separation of grease-metallic soap-graphite-MoS2 particles, which is typical of this type of products when they work under pressure by the centralized pump system. HYTAK 500 NB can be applied through immersion, paddle wheel, circulation and spray lubrication of mill bearings and large girth gear drives.

HPCL-LBS-0048.title: NU-MATIC
HPCL-LBS-0048.subTitle: Pneumatic tool oils
HPCL-LBS-0048.description: NU-MATIC is a line of first quality rock drill lubricants formulated for the lubrication of pneumatic tools. They have pronounced extreme-pressure and rust-preventive properties. They contain a tackiness agent to give good adhesive characteristics and an emulsifying agent that helps in forming highly stable emulsions in the presence of water. They are formulated to provide effective protection to metal surfaces against acidic corrosion.
HPCL-LBS-0048.appData: These oils are recommended for lubrication of pneumatic equipment such as rock drills, jack hammers, stoppers, drifters, chippers, wagon drills, tempers & pavement breakers etc. They are also used in small in-plant pneumatic tools like grinders, filing tools, drills, tapers, impact wrenches, rivetters, hoists etc.

HPCL-LBS-0052.description: HPCL SEETUL S 68 are fully synthetic lubricants, designed for use in refrigeration compressors and heat pumps. HPCL-LBS-0127.title: ELASTO SUPREME (TRAE)
HPCL-LBS-0127.subTitle: RUBBER PROCESS OILS
HPCL-LBS-0127.description:
Aromatic process oils are primarily used in the manufacture of tyres. A typical tyre tread may contain a substantial weight of this aromatic extender Oil. These oils contain Poly Aromatic Hydrocarbons (PAH) / Polycylic Aromatic Hydrocarbons (PCA). It has been scientifically proved that a PCA Content of more than 3% weight is directly proportional to the risk of cancer in human beings. The PCAs are released to the environment during the process of tyre wear and manufacture.

The content of PCA/PAH need to be controlled to ensure that the product does not damage the environment. ELASTO SUPREME is a treated residual aromatic extract (TRAE) type product which has been designed to prevent damage to the environment and at the same time contribute to the high end performance of modern automobile tyre and Styrene Butadiene Rubber (SBR).

HPCL-LBS-0128.title: ELASTO SUPREME H (RAE)
HPCL-LBS-0128.subTitle: RUBBER PROCESS OILS
HPCL-LBS-0128.description:
ELASTO SUPREME H is an environmental friendly RAE type rubber process oil meeting requirement of COMMISSION REGULATION EC 552/2009- Amending regulation EC No.1907/2006(REACH)

It meets EU Directive requirement of the harmful PAH content (sum of specified 8 items as per EU Directive) less than 10 ppm and Benzo(a)pyrene less than 1 ppm.

This non-staining rubber process oil is a pure mineral oil containing high amount of aromatics for superior degree of solubility of rubber components.

ELASTO SUPREME H is a Residual Aromatic Extract directly obtained from refining process and unlike other blended products minimizes the chances of de-mixing and ensure predictable performance. It is a potential substitute for DAE used as plasticizer/Extender oils in rubber and tyres.
HPCL-LBS-0128.appData:
ELASTO SUPREME H is recommended for use in natural and synthetic rubber for compounding along with other ingredients to improve the workability of the finished rubber in the desired application.

It is mostly recommended for tire and rubber compound applications and delivers a right balance between wet grip and rolling resistance.

Thanks to its high aromatic content and balanced composition between aromatic, naphthenic and paraffinic molecules, it offers excellent compatibility with rubbers such as SBR, NR.

HPCL-LBS-0129.title: HP ELASTO 165, 245, 255

Rubber process oils can be broadly classified into three basic groups depending on the physical arrangement of the carbon atoms namely, paraffinic, naphthenic and aromatics.

All petroleum oils are mixtures of various hydrocarbon groups and their classification is arbitrary and is based on the predominance of a particular hydrocarbon group.

HP ELASTO 165,245 and 255 are predominantly paraffinic rubber process oils suitable for use as plasticizers. ELASTO 165 and 255 are highly paraffinic.
HPCL-LBS-0129.appData: ELASTO 165 is suitable for use in EPDM RUBBERS. ELASTO 245 is particularly suitable for use in butyl and ethylene propylene rubbers and light coloured rubbers. ELASTO 255 is specially developed for shoe sole applications.

RUSTOP 273 is soft film, solvent deposited, water displacing type, corrosion preventives specifically developed for the roller bearing industry.

SALIENT FEATURES

Easy to apply and remove using degreasing agents
Can be removed by wiping off with rags/waste soaked in SKO/MTO/Alkaline degreasents or solvent degreasing methods

Suitable for use just before parts that are packaged for storage or shipment
Provides long term protection under more adverse conditions with formation of heavy duty thin film

Also recommended for PHEV & HEV type Electric Commercial Vehicles.

HP MILCY FUTUR-X  is a super-premium quality diesel engine oil made from the finest paraffinic base stocks and state of art additive technology, specifically for the modern low emission diesel engines, employing after treatment devices.

HP MILCY FUTUR-X  is designed on a low SAPS platform to provide fuel efficiency benefits and with exceptional low temperature performance. It enhances protection against oil oxidation, viscosity loss due to shear and oil aeration, as well as catalyst poisoning. The Low SAPS technology helps in preventing particulate filter blocking, engine wear, piston deposits, degradation of low- and high-temperature properties and soot-related viscosity increase. The high temperature oxidation stability will help in extending drain interval of the oil. While, its exceptional soot dispersancy provides optimum control on oil thickening & filter clogging; the advanced detergency in the product exhibits exemplary control on piston deposit.
HPCL-LBS-0321.appData: New generation BS VI diesel engines of heavy commercial, multi utility as well as small cars employing DPF, Exhaust Gas Recirculation (EGR)/ Cooled EGR/SCR type after treatment devices. The product also yields tangible benefits on longer engine oil life, better engine health in regular BS II/BS III/BS IV compliant engines requiring engine oil meeting API CF-4/CH-4/CI-4/CI-4 Plus performance level

HPCL-NGS-0001.title: Liquified Natural Gas
HPCL-NGS-0001.description: LNG is a clean, high-calorific cryogenic fuel produced by cooling Natural Gas (predominantly Methane, CH₄) to approximately −162 °C, condensing it into liquid form and reducing its volume by approximately 600 times for economical long-distance transport and large-scale storage. It is colourless and odourless in its natural liquid state, non-toxic, and reverts to gaseous Methane upon regasification at LNG terminals or satellite stations. LNG is produced at large-scale liquefaction plants fed by natural gas fields or associated gas streams from petroleum processing.
HPCL-NGS-0001.appData:
•	Fuel for LNG-powered mining fleets and ships (bunkering)
•	Peak shaving & regasification for city gas pipeline networks
•	Industrial fuel for large captive power plants & process industries
•	Satellite LNG supply to remote areas lacking pipeline connectivity
•	Feedstock for petrochemical & fertiliser plants
packaging:
•	ISO LNG cryogenic road tankers (10–40 KL)
•	Cryogenic storage tanks at satellite stations
•	LNG terminal bulk above-ground storage tanks
•	Pipeline regasified supply post-terminal
related: •	HPLNG ( selling through natural gas SBU)

HPCL-NGS-0002.title: Domestic
HPCL-NGS-0002.description: PNG-D is a clean, safe, and economical gaseous fuel consisting predominantly of Methane (CH₄), delivered directly to residential households through an underground pipeline network at low pressure. It is colourless and odourless in natural form (odorised with Ethyl Mercaptan for leak detection), non-toxic, and lighter than air, ensuring natural dissipation in case of leakage. PNG-D completely eliminates the need for LPG cylinder storage, booking, and handling  offering an uninterrupted metered supply billed on actual consumption. It is produced from domestic natural gas fields or via regasification of LNG, distributed through PNGRB-authorised City Gas Distribution (CGD) networks.
HPCL-NGS-0002.appData:
•	Domestic cooking on PNG-compatible gas burners & hobs
•	Water heating via gas geysers & boilers
•	Space heating in colder regions
•	Backup power through small residential gas gensets
packaging:
•	Underground pipeline at domestic low pressure
•	Meter board connection installed at flat / home
•	Online meter reading & digital billing
•	24×7 uninterrupted supply — no cylinder or refill wait
related: HPOIL Gas Private Limited (HOGPL) Aavantika Gas Limited (AGL): Bhagyanagar Gas Limited (BGL) Godavari Gas Private Limited (GGPL)

HPCL-NGS-0003.title: Industrial
HPCL-NGS-0003.description: PNG-I is a clean, high-calorific, and cost-efficient gaseous fuel comprising predominantly Methane (CH₄), delivered through a dedicated high-pressure pipeline network to industrial consumers for large-scale process heating, power generation, and manufacturing operations. It is colourless and odourless in its natural form (odorised in applicable pressure zones for safety), non-toxic, and produces significantly lower emissions compared to coal, furnace oil, or diesel. PNG-I enables industries to achieve higher thermal efficiency, reduce maintenance costs of combustion equipment, and meet environmental compliance norms. It is sourced from national gas grids (HVJ, DVPL, GREP pipelines) or LNG regasification terminals through authorised CGD and direct pipeline connections.
HPCL-NGS-0003.appData:
•	Process heating, drying & calcination in kilns & furnaces
•	Captive power generation via gas turbines & reciprocating engines
•	Steam generation in industrial boilers
•	Metal reheating, annealing & heat treatment furnaces
•	Glass melting, ceramics firing & brick kilns
•	Textile processing (stenters), rubber curing & tyre manufacturing
•	Feedstock for fertiliser (ammonia synthesis) & petrochemical plants
packaging:
•	Dedicated high-pressure pipeline (direct industrial connection)
•	SCADA-monitored custody transfer metering stations
•	Pressure regulation at battery limit of plant
•	Long-term Gas Supply Agreements (GSA)
related: HPOIL Gas Private Limited (HOGPL) Aavantika Gas Limited (AGL): Bhagyanagar Gas Limited (BGL) Godavari Gas Private Limited (GGPL)

HPCL-NGS-0004.title: Commercial
HPCL-NGS-0004.description: PNG-C is a clean, efficient, and high-calorific gaseous fuel comprising predominantly Methane (CH₄), supplied continuously through a dedicated underground pipeline network to commercial consumers. It is colourless and odourless in its natural form (odorised with Ethyl Mercaptan for safety and leak detection), non-toxic, and lighter than air. PNG-C eliminates cylinder dependency for commercial kitchens and catering operations, offering uninterrupted supply through metered connections. It is sourced from natural gas fields or regasified LNG through City Gas Distribution (CGD) networks authorised by PNGRB.

HPCL-FTX-0001.title: HP Milcy  Futur-X 15W-40
HPCL-FTX-0001.description: HP MILCY FUTUR-X 15W-40 is a super-premium quality diesel engine oil formulated with high quality paraffinic base stocks and state-of-the-art additive technology. It is specifically designed for modern low-emission diesel engines equipped with After-Treatment Devices such as Diesel Particulate Filter (DPF), Exhaust Gas Recirculation (EGR), Cooled EGR, and Selective Catalytic Reduction (SCR). HP MILCY FUTUR-X 15W-40 is formulated on a low-SAPS platform to provide enhanced protection against oil oxidation, viscosity loss due to shear, oil aeration, catalyst poisoning, particulate filter blocking, engine wear, piston deposits, degradation of low- and high temperature properties, and soot-related viscosity increase. Its excellent high-temperature oxidation stability helps extend oil drain intervals. The product’s exceptional soot dispersancy controls oil thickening and filter clogging, while its advanced detergency ensures superior piston cleanliness.
HPCL-FTX-0001.appData: HP MILCY FUTUR-X 15W-40 is recommended for new-generation BS-VI diesel engines in heavy commercial vehicles, multi-utility vehicles, and small diesel cars equipped with DPF, EGR/Cooled EGR, or SCR after-treatment systems. It also delivers significant benefits in engine protection and oil life in regular BS-II/BS-III/BS-IV compliant engines requiring oils meeting API CF-4/CH-4/CI-4/CI-4 Plus performance levels. Additionally, the product is suitable for PHEV and HEV-type electric commercial vehicles
